decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive board state by utilizing low-cost creatures and utilizing cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Goblin Bushwhacker to flood the board with tokens and pump up the team for a quick win. It also includes some disruption with Esper Sentinel and removal with cards like Gleeful Demolition. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently, utilizing a combination of creature aggression and spell disruption to take control of the game early on.

This Rakdos Aggro deck is focused on quickly disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also putting pressure on them with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Terminate and build up card advantage with Seasoned Pyromancer. Blood Moon can also disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck is designed to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's plans, and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. It also utilizes cards like Leyline Binding and Chalice of the Void to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of a companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, provides an additional advantage. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure the deck has access to the necessary colors and resources. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

The key concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 Aggro deck is centered around utilizing the synergy between The Underworld Cookbook and other cards such as Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, Gilded Goose, and Ovalchase Daredevil to create a powerful engine that generates value and card advantage. The deck aims to capitalize on Academy Manufactor's ability to create additional tokens and trigger the Cookbook's ability, while also leveraging Finale of Devastation to tutor important creatures or close out the game. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional utility and options for the deck's strategy.

This Hardened Scales Aggro deck focuses on maximizing +1/+1 counters on creatures by utilizing cards like Hardened Scales, Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp, and The Ozolith. The deck includes efficient creatures like Hangarback Walker and Walking Ballista, as well as synergistic artifacts like Welding Jar and Springleaf Drum. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts and lands like Inkmoth Nexus. By consistently growing creatures and utilizing counters, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a quick and powerful aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly cycling through cards and filling the graveyard with creatures, then using spells like Violent Outburst to cascade into Living End and bring all those creatures back onto the battlefield for a powerful combo finish. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of creatures while disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Negation. It also utilizes cards like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves for additional card advantage and protection. Overall, the goal is to quickly assemble the combo and win the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on using cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Striped Riverwinder to quickly fill up the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. Violent Outburst and Waker of Waves provide additional ways to trigger the combo. Force of Negation helps protect the combo while cards like Grief and Shardless Agent disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a massive board presence generated from the graveyard, allowing for quick and decisive victories.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It uses various colorless utility cards like Karn Liberated, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Engineered Explosives to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Sundering Titan and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim to pressure the opponent while maintaining control. Additionally, it includes a toolbox of artifact cards like Expedition Map and Karn, the Great Creator to find answers and win conditions as needed.

The deck focuses on cycling creatures to the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring them back onto the battlefield all at once. It aims to disrupt opponents with hand disruption spells like Grief and counter spells like Force of Negation. The creatures in the deck have abilities that can help dig deeper into the deck or provide additional value when brought back with Living End. The deck also includes some counter spells and control elements to protect the combo.

The deck revolves around quickly cycling through cards to fill the graveyard, then using spells like Violent Outburst to cascade into Living End, bringing back powerful creatures from the graveyard. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient combo that can be difficult to disrupt. The deck includes ways to protect the combo with counterspells like Force of Negation and disruptive creatures like Grief. By utilizing the graveyard as a resource, the deck aims to win the game through explosive plays and overwhelming board presence.

The key concept of this deck is fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing cards like Grief and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to disrupt the opponent's hand and quickly empty their resources. The deck also focuses on control elements with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate to deal with threats from the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect and recur key creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Seasoned Pyromancer. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and control elements in a Rakdos color scheme.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards like Underworld Breach, Mishra's Bauble, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to create a powerful combo that allows for quick and efficient spells to be cast from the graveyard. The goal is to generate card advantage and tempo by constantly recurring spells and disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of consistency and flexibility to the deck. The deck aims to win through a combination of card advantage, disruption, and efficient spellcasting.

The deck revolves around assembling a combo involving Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Leyline Binding. Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce provide protection while Wrenn and Six help with card advantage and fetching lands. The deck also includes a few versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Fire/Ice for removal and additional utility. The overall strategy focuses on using creative and unconventional ways to overwhelm the opponent and secure the win.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes control elements like Karn Liberated, Ugin the Spirit Dragon, and Oblivion Stone to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck includes powerful threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine to quickly close out games. Additionally, Karn, the Great Creator can tutor for artifacts like Witchbane Orb or Ensnaring Bridge to further control the game. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional speed and consistency element to the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to cycle through your deck quickly by discarding cards like Grief and Architects of Will to then use cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Striped Riverwinder and Curator of Mysteries, overwhelming your opponent with a quick and powerful board presence. The deck aims to execute this combo efficiently and disrupt your opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Negation and Shardless Agent, while also having some control elements with Waker of Waves and Generous Gift.

The deck focuses on using cards like Living End and Violent Outburst to quickly cycle through the deck and reanimate creatures from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent. It also utilizes cascading effects from cards like Shardless Agent to dig for key combo pieces. The deck includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation to protect the combo. By cycling through the deck quickly and reanimating powerful creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Striped Riverwinder, the deck aims to outpace and outvalue the opponent in a way that is difficult to interact with.
